decisiones.patron: 4 dos fallas, una vale la pena

decision_cruda.rationale: Both failures are confirmed by radio and CMMS. LH-10 is an idle spare, so lending it costs nothing. At Este (10.5 g/t, repair likely 13:30) it nets +9.9 oz. At Central (5.8 g/t, repair likely 11:30) a loan nets only +1.3 oz, and every other lender has a negative net. So I send LH-10 to Este and leave Central uncovered.
